Hover and signature help, for a client that shows Markdown and reads a
parameter as offsets in the signature's label: a function with the
comment above it, the auto object's, a kfun of the driver's and one the
project declares, a variable, a macro, a header, an object, a label, a
parameter, a call whose receiver nobody knows; then the arguments of
calls.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
dialect:
  kfuns: ["int *rusage()"]
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
auto_object = "/sys/auto";
-- lib/include/std.h --
/* Grundläggande */ #define BASE "/std/base"
// The square of x.
#define SQUARE(x) ((x)*(x))
-- lib/sys/auto.c --
/* Tells the user. */
static void write(string s) {}
-- lib/std/base.c --
/* blåbær, in grams */
int weight;

/*
 * Sets the weight.
 *   1. *Not* below zero.
 *
 * # See query_weight().
 */
varargs void set_weight(int grams, string why...) {}
void create() {}
-- lib/std/side.c --
void create() {}
-- lib/obj/a.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit BASE;
inherit side "/std/side";
void create() { /* først 🫐 */ ::create(); set_weight(SQUARE(2), "a", "b"); }
void f(object ob) { write("x"); weight = strlen("blåbær"); rusage(); ob->set_weight(1); "/std/base"->set_weight(1, "x"); side::create(); call_out("f", 1, ob); }
